projectContext: Sprint 16 continues the testing focus by targeting the deepest coverage gaps: self-healing agent healers (5 of 7 healer classes have zero tests), compilation module (695 lines at ~10% coverage), matching scoring private helpers (7 functions with 0 tests), LLM client error/retry paths (exceptions.py, retry.py, parsers.py untested), CLI utility modules (environment.py, logging_setup.py, cache_commands.py with 0 tests), and media_sources Unsplash image client (0% coverage). These modules handle error recovery, pipeline resilience, and user-facing CLI functionality with critical untested code paths.

userStories.title: Add CheckpointHealer and DiskHealer agent tests
userStories.notes: Pre-implemented: 64 tests passing (31 CheckpointHealer + 33 DiskHealer) across test_checkpoint_healer.py and test_disk_healer.py. All 6 acceptance criteria met.
acceptanceCriteria: Test CheckpointHealer.can_heal() returns True for checkpoint-related errors (JSONDecodeError, missing checkpoint, corrupted stages dict) and False for unrelated errors (network, API)
Test CheckpointHealer.heal() restores from backup when primary checkpoint is corrupted — verify .fixed() returned and backup data loaded correctly
Test CheckpointHealer.heal() returns .failed() when both primary and backup are corrupted — verify no exception raised, failure reason logged
Test DiskHealer.can_heal() returns True for disk space errors (OSError errno 28, 'No space left') and permission errors (errno 13) — False for network errors
Test DiskHealer.heal() attempts cleanup of temp files and stale cache when disk full — verify cleanup actions logged via self.log_attempt()
Test both healers use self.log_attempt() and self.log_success() per Rule 20 — verify log methods called with descriptive messages during heal attempts

userStories.title: Add PathHealer and OTIOHealer agent tests
userStories.notes: Added 19 new tests: PathHealer (9 tests — can_handle API/network false, FileNotFoundError, Windows path shortening, missing drive .failed()), OTIOHealer (6 tests — can_handle import/serialization/track corruption true, download errors false, logging verification, reconstruction result), ResilientRunner integration (4 tests — healer selection, healer iteration, max attempts). Total 101 tests passing across both files.
acceptanceCriteria: Test PathHealer.can_heal() returns True for path-related errors (FileNotFoundError, path too long, invalid characters) — False for API or network errors
Test PathHealer.heal() fixes Windows path length issues by shortening paths — verify .fixed() returned with corrected path in result
Test PathHealer.heal() returns .failed() for paths on missing drives (e.g., Z:\nonexistent) — verify descriptive failure reason
Test OTIOHealer.can_heal() returns True for OTIO-related errors (import errors, serialization failures, track corruption) — False for download errors
Test OTIOHealer.heal() attempts OTIO timeline reconstruction when export fails — verify reconstruction steps logged and .fixed() or .failed() returned appropriately
Test both healers integrate with ResilientRunner — mock runner with healer list, trigger matching error, verify correct healer selected and heal() called

userStories.title: Add DownloadHealer and ResilientRunner error path tests
userStories.notes: Added 13 new tests across 3 files: test_healers.py (4 new — can_handle 403/extraction True, config/OTIO errors False), test_download_healer_retry.py (3 new — max tier failure, failure logging, escalation manager max tier), test_runner.py (6 new — RuntimeError crash safety, KeyboardInterrupt propagation, 3-healer iteration, no-match returns False, max attempts limit, orchestrator max_attempts). Total 470 agent tests passing, 0 regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Test DownloadHealer.can_heal() returns True for download errors (403 Forbidden, rate limited, yt-dlp extraction failed) — False for config or OTIO errors
Test DownloadHealer.heal() escalates bypass tier on repeated 403 errors — verify escalation_manager.escalate() called and .fixed() returned for retry
Test DownloadHealer.heal() returns .failed() when max escalation tier reached and all retries exhausted — verify failure logged with tier info
Test ResilientRunner catches exceptions from stage.execute() — mock stage that raises RuntimeError, verify runner does not crash and returns failure result
Test ResilientRunner iterates through healer list to find matching healer — mock 3 healers where only the 2nd can_heal() returns True, verify only 2nd healer's heal() called
Test ResilientRunner respects max_attempts_per_stage from healing config — verify heal() called at most N times before stage marked as permanently failed

acceptanceCriteria: Test GapAnalyzer.analyze() identifies gaps in timeline — mock timeline with 3 clips and 2 gaps, verify gap positions and durations returned correctly

Test CompilationTimelineBuilder.create_timeline() handles empty clip list — verify returns valid but empty timeline without crash

userStories.title: Add matching scoring private helper function tests
acceptanceCriteria: Test _is_jarring_context_switch() returns True for unrelated segment pairs — verify segments with completely different topics/keywords flagged as jarring context switch
Test _is_jarring_context_switch() returns False for related segments and handles None/empty topics — verify no crash on None values, empty strings treated as non-jarring
Test _extract_entity_texts() extracts text from entity dicts — verify handles mixed entity formats (dict with 'text' key, plain strings), returns empty list for None input
Test _looks_like_entity() identifies capitalized multi-word phrases — verify True for 'New York', 'Barack Obama', False for 'the quick', 'is a', handles empty/whitespace strings
Test _calculate_language_consistency() scores transcript coherence — verify high score for well-formed English text, low score for gibberish/repetitive text, handles empty string
Test _calculate_sentence_coherence() scores punctuation patterns — verify high score for properly punctuated text, low for text without punctuation, handles non-ASCII punctuation

userStories.title: Add LLM client exception hierarchy and retry logic tests
acceptanceCriteria: Test LLM exception classes inherit correctly — verify LLMRateLimitError, LLMAuthError, LLMTimeoutError all subclass base LLMError, each carries provider name and original error
Test retry logic applies exponential backoff — mock time.sleep, trigger retryable error 3 times, verify sleep durations follow backoff formula (delay * backoff^attempt)
Test retry logic distinguishes retryable vs non-retryable errors — verify LLMRateLimitError triggers retry, LLMAuthError does NOT trigger retry (fails immediately)
Test retry logic respects max_retries config — set max_retries=2, trigger 3 retryable errors, verify only 2 retries attempted then exception raised
Test LLM response parser handles malformed JSON — feed parser truncated JSON, JSON with trailing commas, empty string — verify graceful fallback or clear error message for each
